pr.title: fix(security): remove ADHD weak secret defaults
pr.body:
## Problem
ADHD and WMA runtime surfaces still contained weak default secrets after the installer/env-template hardening slice.

## Fix
- Remove weak compose defaults for ADHD Engine and WMA secrets.
- Sanitize ADHD Engine API key config and fail closed outside dev/test/local runtimes.
- Sanitize legacy WMA secrets and generate ephemeral local-only development values.
- Stop the WMA ADHD client from sending dev-key-123 and use X-API-Key for explicit keys.
- Add focused unit tests and update the ADHD API auth note.

## Test Plan
- Validate Task Packet JSON and schema.
- Run focused ADHD/WMA secret tests.
- Validate compose rendering without starting services.
- Run compileall, git diff --check, and pre-commit on changed files.

steps.task: Inspect remaining ADHD and WMA weak default secret surfaces across compose, active runtime config, legacy WMA support code, docs, and tests.
requirements: Distinguish active ADHD Engine runtime from duplicate historical ADHD paths.
Treat working-memory-assistant main.py as legacy support unless runtime evidence proves active compose authority.
Do not widen into installer/env-template behavior already covered by TP-SEC-WEAK-DEFAULT-SECRETS-001.

steps.task: Remove weak compose/code defaults and add non-dev fail-closed secret validation.
requirements: Compose must not inject dev-key-123 or dev-only-change-me.
ADHD Engine must treat missing or placeholder API keys as absent in dev/test/local and fatal outside those environments.
Legacy WMA support must not use static token/encryption defaults and must only generate ephemeral values in dev/test/local.
Explicit WMA ADHD client keys must use the ADHD Engine X-API-Key contract.

steps.task: Run packet validation, focused validation, PAL review/precommit, pre-commit, commit, push, PR, and update Task Orchestrator with proof.
requirements: Report any untested live-service behavior as NOT_RUN.
